jurisdictions.brief:
Egypt is modernizing its IP framework to attract investment. It is a member of the Paris Convention and the PCT.

Direct filings can claim priority within 12 months. PCT applications can enter the national phase within 30 months.
jurisdictions.details:
Required documents:
Power of attorney, legalized by the Egyptian consulate (4 months).
Certified priority document (3 months).

Language:
English at filing. Arabic translation of the specification, claims and drawings within 6 months.

Deadlines:
Request for examination within 3 months of notification. Annuities are paid yearly.

jurisdictions.brief: The UAE accepts PCT national phase entry within 30 months and requires notarized documents within 90 days of filing.
jurisdictions.details:
PCT filing requirements:
Notarized power of attorney (90 days).
Notarized commercial register extract (90 days).
Arabic translation of the specification (90 days).

Annuities:
Paid yearly. A 3-month grace period applies.

jurisdictions.brief: Saudi Arabia requires a notarized power of attorney and specifications in English and Arabic.
jurisdictions.details:
PCT filing requirements:
Notarized power of attorney, apostilled or legalized.
Specification in English and Arabic.

Annuities:
Paid between January 1 and March 31 each year.
